title: Merged Intervals
prompt:
**Description:** Given n intervals [l_i, r_i], merge all overlapping or
touching intervals and print the merged intervals sorted by start.

**Input:** Line 1: n (1 <= n <= 10^5). Next n lines: l r (0 <= l <= r <= 10^9).
**Output:** Each merged interval on its own line: `l r`.

**Example:** `4` / `1 3` / `2 6` / `8 10` / `15 18` -> `1 6` / `8 10` / `15 18`.

tests.name: sample
tests.hint: 1 3 and 2 6 touch; the rest stay separate.

tests.name: nested
touching
